description: Returns the Medicare IRMAA tier a MAGI sets: the official 2026 tier (from 2024 MAGI) and the 2027 and 2028 tiers (from 2025 and 2026 MAGI) on the tables as QuantCalc projects them, labelled projected; with each the monthly Part B and Part D surcharge per person, the annual total for the people on Medicare, and the distance to the next tier. Reads the same CMS tables as the website's IRMAA calculator. Free: no licence needed.

both_spouses_on_medicare.description: Joint return only: both spouses are on Medicare (the surcharge is per person). Default true, stated.

cpi_assumption_percent.description: The CPI-U assumption of the projected 2028 floors and the 2027-2028 surcharge amounts: 2.0, 2.5 (default) or 3.0. The 2027 floors do not depend on it: they come from the published CPI-U, as on /irmaa-brackets-2027/.

filing_status.description: Filing status: single, married filing jointly (mfj), married filing separately (mfs) or head of household (hoh).

magi.description: Modified AGI (AGI plus tax-exempt interest) of the 2024 return, which sets the 2026 premiums; also used for 2025 and 2026 unless they are given.

magi_2025.description: 2025 MAGI, which sets the 2027 premiums. Default: magi.

magi_2026.description: 2026 MAGI, which sets the 2028 premiums. Default: magi.

name: irmaa_check
title: Medicare IRMAA tier for a MAGI
